why: Expression cycle 4 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-4.md) logged `primitive` findings that need no new export and no contract change: shipped components cost 32 round-0 points in builds that used them as documented. The largest is the chart box: a `CartesianChart` inside a `ChartCard` defaults to `height="fill"`, and the fill box renders 320 px whatever the card's box is. At 390 px the card box is 192 px, so the plot overflows by 128 px and loses its x axis, its legend and its goal rule (n16, and cycle 3's n12 today); at 1800 px the box is 375 to 420 px, so 55 to 100 px stay empty under the legend (c15, n16) (lead probe on the round-0 dist, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-4/probe-fill.ts`). Builders paid for it in glue: n04 measured the card box with a ResizeObserver and mounted its chart after measuring, which made loading 80 px shorter than loaded (P2 expression-4.41); c15 pinned the card to `h-136`; n13 pinned the chart to 160 px. P2 .85 is n16's lean-loss fixture at 390 with its extreme cut off. The rest: the figure value and period ellipsize at 390 instead of fitting ('Boreal 7…', '€2,907.…', 'No ride wind…': c14, c15, n04, n13); a StatCard and a DataTable lose height while loading (StatCard 183 against 235 px, six skeleton rows against 18 loaded; P2 .70, n13; n09's strip and table); ArrowRight never leaves the first item when the chart's data is not in x order, while ArrowLeft walks it (c15, lead probe `probe-keys.ts`; its builder wrote its own key handler in round 1); a focus `group` announces its internal id ('skip-0: Mon 14:00 …', n04); a custom `rect` mark does not draw once a bar series shares the axis, so n04 drew rain as a step line that has nothing to dim; `c.delta` with money prints '+50€' and '+5.66€' beside '€' prefixes elsewhere (n13); `card: 'hidden'` does not hide a column on the phone cards and `group.by` must name a visible column, so n09 printed its group name on every row and card; the one-tab-stop ring of a seam row list sits over the rows' first letters (c14); dimmed bars in dark are slate on near-black (n13); at a gap the engine tooltip names the nearest datum while the held focus and the hero name another (c15); a StatCell `sub` floats at the cell bottom, away from its value, when a neighbour declares more tracks (n16).
what: Fixes inside existing v3 chart, card and table components: a fill chart fills its card box at every width, the figure fits at 390, loading keeps the loaded height in StatCard and DataTable, arrow order follows x, group announcements carry no id, rect marks draw beside bars, money deltas format as money, hidden columns hide on cards and can group, and four smaller dim, ring, tooltip and track fixes. No new export, no contract.ts change.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/** except contract.ts (box, host, focus, cartesian parts, chart-card parts)
packages/basalt-ui/src/table/** except contract.ts (kinds, phases, card layout, grouping)
unit and layout tests beside them
must_not_touch: apps/playground/src/scenarios/expr/** (the trial builds stay as their builders left them)
change: (1) A `CartesianChart` with `height="fill"` (the default in a `ChartCard`) takes the card box's height at every width: at 390 px nothing of the plot, axis or legend is clipped, and at 1800 px no band is left under the legend (c15, n16, n04, n13; n12 today). (2) A `ChartCard` and `StatCard` figure fits at 390 px: the value steps down a size and the period wraps to a second line before either ellipsizes (c14, c15, n04, n13). (3) `StatCard` and `DataTable` keep their loaded height while loading: the card draws its declared figure, pill and footer rows, and the table draws as many skeleton rows as it will show (its page size, or the row count it knows) (n13, n09). (4) Arrow keys on a chart step in x order, whatever order `data` has (c15). (5) A focus `group` is announced by the first item's announcement or a label, never its key (n04). (6) A custom `rect` mark draws on an axis a bar series also uses (n04). (7) `c.delta` with a currency formats like `c.money` ('+€50.00'), and a zero delta reads as a dash (n13). (8) `card: 'hidden'` hides a column on the phone cards, and `group.by` may name a hidden column (n09). (9) The focus ring of a seam row list is inset clear of the rows' text (c14). (10) Dimmed bars keep the dim contrast in dark that rows got in v3-expr-3-kit-fixes (3) (n13). (11) While a held focus spans a gap, the tooltip names the focused datum, not the nearest one (c15). (12) A StatCell `sub` sits under its value whatever tracks its neighbours declare (n16). Items (4) to (12) each serve one case; they are defects in shipped behaviour, not new capabilities, so the two-case rule for new capability does not apply.
commits: fix: commits in packages/basalt-ui, one per item or per component.
proof: make check; a layout test per item where a page can show it (1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12), unit tests for the rest; shots of the cycle-4 scenarios at 390 and 1800 before and after for (1) and (2).
acceptance: A fill chart in a ChartCard at 390 px shows its x axis and legend unclipped, and at 1800 px leaves no empty band under the legend (layout test)
A ChartCard figure of 9 characters plus a period of 30 fits at 390 px without an ellipsis (layout test)
A StatCard and a DataTable are the same height loading and loaded (layout test)
ArrowRight steps through a chart whose data is sorted by descending x (unit test)
Items (5) to (12) each have a test, or the PR says which were left out and why
out_of_scope: ChartPlot pixel scales and x-range zones (v3-expr-4-contract); skill text (v3-expr-4-skill); a horizontal bar kind or a two-segment progress part (c14's wishes, one case each: a recipe at most).
